description: This Java class 'GatewayHttpConfig' implements HTTP configuration for the Ditto Gateway service, including settings for hostname, port, schema versions, HTTPS enforcement, CORS, timeouts, headers, media types, and shutdown timeout.

classes.name: GatewayHttpConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing HTTP configuration for the Ditto Gateway, with methods to load configuration from a Config object and access various HTTP settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of GatewayHttpConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname for the HTTP server.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the HTTP server.

methods.name: getCoordinatedShutdownTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for coordinated shutdown.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the set of supported JSON schema versions.

methods.name: isRedirectToHttps
methods.description: Indicates whether redirect to HTTPS is enabled.

methods.name: getRedirectToHttpsBlocklistPattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern for URLs to block from redirecting to HTTPS.

methods.name: getActorPropsFactoryFullQualifiedClassname
methods.description: Returns the full qualified class name for the actor props factory.

methods.name: getQueryParametersAsHeaders
methods.description: Returns the set of query parameters interpreted as headers.

methods.name: getAdditionalAcceptedMediaTypes
methods.description: Returns additional media types accepted by the server.
